teaser.en: A wild grape with five-fingered leaves, scrambling through the coastal bush.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori wenye majani ya vidole vitano, unaotambaa katikati ya vichaka vya pwani.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni wenye makodza ga vyala tsano dza mkpwono, unaoambala kahi ya vitsaka vya pwani.

summary.en: Mwamchiviza is Cyphostemma buchananii, a climber of the grape family. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mwamchiviza ni Cyphostemma buchananii, mmea unaotambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Pakia anaripoti jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: Mwamchiviza ni Cyphostemma buchananii, libugu ra jamii ya mzabibu. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mwamchiviza is a climbing or trailing herb of the grape family, with tendrils opposite the leaves. Like other Cyphostemmas it has leaves divided like a hand into several toothed leaflets, flat-topped clusters of tiny greenish-yellow flowers and small, juicy berries that ripen red.
about.sw: Mwamchiviza ni mmea unaopanda au kutambaa wa familia ya mizabibu, wenye vikonyo upande wa pili wa majani. Kama Cyphostemma nyingine, una majani yaliyogawanyika kama kiganja cha mkono kuwa vijani kadhaa vyenye meno, mafungu yenye juu bapa ya maua madogo sana ya rangi ya kijani-manjano, na matunda madogo ya beri yenye majimaji yanayoiva na kuwa mekundu.
about.dg: Mwamchiviza ni mmea wa jamii ya mzabibu unaodzilinga-linga dzulu au unaoambala photsi, wenye nyuzi zinazomera zichilolana na makodza. Dza Cyphostemma zanjina, una makodza ganayoganywa dza mkpwono kukala makodza madide machache genye meno, mafungu ga maruwa madide sana ga chijani na rangi ya mandano genye dzulu sambamba, na matunda madide genye madzi manji ganayoivwa kukala ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in bushland and thicket, scrambling over shrubs.
where.sw: Huota vichakani na kwenye vichaka vizito, ukitambaa juu ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera weruni na vitsakani, uchiambala dzulu ya vitsaka.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwamchiviza but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Cyphostemma buchananii.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwamchiviza lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Cyphostemma buchananii.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwamchiviza, ela kalavya manage wala madzina ga luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Cyphostemma buchananii.

reason.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni urioandikpwa kanda-kanda na uhu
